title: GHL build manifest
description: Record of every asset a funnel build created or modified. This is what makes reruns idempotent and rollback possible, so it is written as assets are created, not at the end of a run.

location_id.description: Sub-account every asset below belongs to. A manifest never spans locations.

prefix.description: Asset name prefix, e.g. CAJ. Assets without it are out of scope for this build.

completed_at.description: Null while a build is in progress or after it failed partway.

status.description: A dry_run manifest records what WOULD be created; nothing was written.

type.description: Listed in dependency order — later types reference earlier ones.

id.description: GHL-assigned ID. Null for dry-run entries and for assets whose creation failed.

action.description: skipped_exists is the idempotent path: search-before-create found a match.

depends_on.description: Names of assets that must exist first. Used to order reruns after a partial failure.

manual_steps.description: Anything the tool layer could not do, carried into the handoff report rather than silently dropped.
